description.value: Tsukiya is a compact ramen shop on Denman Street in Vancouver's West End, just steps from Stanley Park and the seawall cycling route. The restaurant specializes in house-made tonkotsu ramen featuring a rich pork bone broth and specially crafted chewy noodles. It operates on a walk-in-only basis with no reservations, making it an accessible spontaneous stop for cyclists exploring the area.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 65m; stands (2 spaces) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m. Total: 6 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the address, provides a phone number not in OSM, and explicitly states takeout is available in-store only and that there is no vegan option. OSM opening hours differ substantially from the website (OSM lists Mon-Tue 12:00-23:00 and Thu-Sun, while the website lists Fri-Tue 11:30am-8:30pm with Wed-Thu closed), so the website hours are treated as authoritative. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere.
concerns: OSM opening hours (Mo-Tu 12:00-23:00; Th-Su 12:00-23:00) differ substantially from website hours (Fri-Tue 11:30am-8:30pm; Wed-Thu closed). Website hours treated as authoritative.
OSM record contains no phone number; website contact page lists 604-609-0310. Phone value sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Tsukiya is a legitimate restaurant on a major cycling corridor near Stanley Park, but no required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. On-site verification is recommended before including in the directory.
